summary: F.2 Presentation Sequencing V2 — Backend GREEN (12/12 new + 33/33 regression). Frontend editor (PageInspector tab, 6 IT transitions, autosave, Presenta button, keyboard nav, chapter overlay, Esc exit) GREEN. PUBLIC /presentation/{token} route BROKEN: hard-redirects to /auth/login because PublicPresentation.jsx calls auth-gated /api/moodboards/_meta/presentation_transitions and the global axios 401 interceptor in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js (line 29-31) forcefully bounces to /auth/login before the local .catch can fall back. This breaks the client-safe share experience entirely.

integration_issues.issue: PublicPresentation.jsx fetches the auth-gated /api/moodboards/_meta/presentation_transitions endpoint. That call returns 401 for unauthenticated visitors and the global axios interceptor in lib/api.js hard-redirects to /auth/login, so the public share link is unusable. Visited URL /presentation/PXSdp8bsX6b4sjdhok2zL74w5yAciKeQ resolves to the login page instead of PresentationMode. The presentation-mode/loading/error testids never mount (DOM check returned all false).

action_items: Fix public route: either (a) remove the /_meta/presentation_transitions fetch from PublicPresentation.jsx (the component already falls back to fade) or (b) expose a public variant of the transitions endpoint (e.g. /api/moodboards/public/_meta/presentation_transitions) with no auth dependency, or (c) make the existing endpoint public since it returns only a static catalog. Preferred: option (a)+(c) — drop the call AND make /_meta/presentation_transitions auth-free since the registry has no tenant data.
Optional: harden lib/api.js interceptor to skip the hard redirect when window.location.pathname.startsWith('/presentation/') so future public surfaces don't get bounced.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/moodboards/_meta/presentation_transitions returns exactly 6 transitions (fade/dissolve/slow_slide_left/slow_slide_up/cinematic_zoom/soft_blur_crossfade). Each has cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1) easing and duration_ms in 700-1000ms range (premium, not flashy). GPU-only properties (opacity/transform/filter) in css.from/to as required.

PUT /pages/{pid} correctly merges F.2 fields under settings JSONB (verified preexisting skeleton_id survives the merge). Invalid transition_in/out → 400 with descriptive error. Empty string chapter_label correctly clears the key. Legacy fields (title, hidden_in_presentation) still write to structured columns.
GET /public/share/{token} now returns pages array, filters hidden_from_client pages and drops blocks whose page_id belongs to filtered pages. 403 enforced when status='draft'.

POST /api/templates/inject-into/{moodboard_id} appends template_pages after the existing max sort_order, preserves existing pages, clones template_blocks with placeholder metadata, returns {moodboard_id, pages_added, blocks_added, first_new_page_id}. Tenant-scoped (studio2 → 404 on cross-tenant moodboard, verified). Unknown template_id/moodboard_id → 404.

Frontend editor: 'Pagina' tab (data-testid=tab-page) appears between Inspector and Layers. Italian labels active by default — transition select shows: Dissolvenza / Cross-dissolve / Slide lento · sinistra / Slide lento · alto / Zoom cinematografico / Blur crossfade (6 options). All inspector fields render: page-title-input, page-chapter-input, page-transition-in, page-transition-duration, page-hidden-from-client, page-hidden-in-presentation.
Frontend autosave verified: chapter_label='Concept' + transition_in='cinematic_zoom' persisted via PUT and survived reload (settings.transition_in === 'cinematic_zoom' on next GET).

PresentationMode V2 opens on Presenta click, is fullscreen overlay (covers viewport), ArrowRight/ArrowLeft change page, 'c' opens presentation-chapters-panel, Escape exits cleanly (presentation-mode unmounts).

BUG: /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js global interceptor blindly redirects any 401 to /auth/login. This is incompatible with public surfaces — currently breaks /presentation/{token}. The unconditional redirect should ignore requests originating from /presentation/* and /moodboard/share/* routes.

rca of the issue: Public route /presentation/:shareToken (PublicPresentation.jsx) issues TWO axios calls on mount: GET /api/moodboards/public/share/{token} (public, OK) AND GET /api/moodboards/_meta/presentation_transitions (auth-gated via require_permission(P_MOODBOARDS_READ)). The second call returns 401 for an unauthenticated visitor. The axios response interceptor in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js (lines 29-31) does `window.location.href = '/auth/login'` on any 401 regardless of route — this preempts the local .catch fallback and tears the user out of the share experience entirely. Reproduction: open /presentation/{any-valid-token} in private/incognito mode → page flashes then lands on the login form. Mitigation (recommended): (1) remove the transitions fetch from PublicPresentation.jsx (PresentationMode safely defaults to 'fade'), AND (2) drop require_permission from the /_meta/presentation_transitions endpoint since the catalog is purely static. Optionally also guard the lib/api.js interceptor to skip redirect on /presentation/* + /moodboard/share/* paths.
